# Git commit message instructions

- Use Conventional Commits: `type(scope): summary`.
- Types: feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor, test, perf, build, ci.
- Summary: imperative, lowercase, no trailing period, max 72 chars.
- If the branch name starts with an issue number (e.g. `feat/42-...`), add a footer `Closes #42`. Never invent an issue number.
- No `Co-Authored-By` or AI attribution.
